column7: The role-scoped secret listing (ListSecretsInScopeWithSharingInfo, tiers 1 and 2 of ListReadableSecrets: GET /api/v1/secrets, gRPC ListSecrets) refused with ErrShareListOverCap when the viewer had 10000 or more received shares, so anyone able to share that many secrets with a user denied that user their secret listing. There the shares only decorate rows the role already makes visible; sharedSecretDecorations now uses the capped fetch as it is (IsShared/UserPermission under-reported for shares past the cap, fails safe), logs it, and the list answers. The share-list endpoints and tier 3 (shares are the rows) still refuse (REVIEW-3018). Red on main. Tier matrix: TestListReadableSecrets_ShareFetchAtTheCap; guard exemption in TestShareListFetchCallersRefuseAtTheCap.
